decisions.reason: After two seasons on the market, this LED track spotlight line sits squarely in the firm's core design, track-system and dealer-support knowledge, so management would refine it rather than withdraw it.
The flexible LED spotlight is very close to the firm's established spotlight offer, which gives strong absorptive capacity to interpret early feedback and improve the line.
This multi-outlet ceiling canopy extends the modular-system logic the firm already knows well, so existing technical and planning capabilities make continued development more likely than exit.

The low-voltage multi-outlet canopy is a bit more specialised, but it still builds on the firm's installation and system knowledge enough that management would keep learning and optimising before dropping it.

These round glass track luminaires draw on the firm's design and track expertise, but their weaker website prominence suggests less certain traction, making them the most at risk while still worth keeping for now.
